column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 3 Pandemonium, Mammon aftermath and Inquisition order
# CMP2 group 274 (000FF8F6-00100296). No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies layout.

column2: W-why?!
With that much strength, you should be able to make as much money as you want!
Not everyone lives for money!
The $$七つの大罪$$, despised in this $$世界$$...
even have fools willing to stake their lives on them!
M-money isn't everything?!
With money, you can have $$自由$$ and hire powerful allies!
But that is not necessarily strength of your own...
nor is it true $$自由$$!
Man does not live by bread alone—that's what it means!
$$パルタ$$ said that too!
In the end, before the $$教団$$ that rules the world, you are merely a $$領主$$.
You were a weak creature with nothing but the ties of money binding you...
You people do not know the true terror of money!
There is a huge bounty on your heads! Wherever you go, you will be hunted!
No matter what happens, at least we...
have a path we believe in!!
But in your case...
what you believe in is the real problem!
Not only do you worship $$邪神$$...
you use that power to lead the $$世界$$ into chaos and ruin...
The $$教皇庁$$ at the $$総本山$$ has issued a direct order for your execution!
In the $$教皇$$'s name, we, the Inquisition Crusade...
will execute you!
Like hell!
We're not going to let you kill us just because you say so!
That's right!!
For one thing, we have no desire to destroy this $$世界$$!
No more talking, then!
Attack!
